BOBUX

The Official Currency of BNA

Every 1 module point earns your team 2 BOBUX. Points determine your competition rank; BOBUX is the credit used in the shop. Purchases require admin approval, and item prices increase by 100 BOBUX per event day. Tribulations award points only and never generate BOBUX.

Each perk has one shared limit per module across all teams. It is not a per-team allowance. Choose the module this purchase applies to.

THE VAULT, EXPLAINED

How BNA'27 works

Think of the event as two connected systems: competition creates points, while the vault turns module performance into spending power.

① Choose 3 modules② Earn points③ Convert module points → BOBUX④ Shop⑤ Climb the board
VISUAL GUIDE · POINTS ≠ BOBUX
🧭

1 · Choose your modules

At signup, choose exactly one module from 3 of the 4 groups. Once three are selected, the remaining group locks automatically.

🏆

2 · Score the modules

Module points are the competitive score. Each module can award up to 100 points in total across its rounds.

🪙

3 · Earn BOBUX

Every module point awards 2 BOBUX automatically. Tribulations award points only and never create BOBUX.

🛍️

4 · Spend strategically

Shop requests are reviewed by admins. Nothing is deducted when you request a perk; the balance changes only when the purchase is approved.

📈

5 · Track two rankings

Use the leaderboard toggle to switch between Points and BOBUX. The rankings are separate, with each using its own primary metric.

⚡

6 · Stay live

Scores, purchases, announcements, and standings update from the event backend. Use the refresh button for a soft refresh without returning to signup.
